title: API Route Interface Contract Coverage
description: Current authoritative disposition for implemented local non-UI API routes. Each implemented route must either have a USF-native interface-contract instance or an explicit deferred or rejected disposition. OpenAPI remains a lower-authority projection.
sourceOfRouteTruth: packages/contracts/src/api-surface.ts, checked against packages/openapi/openapi.json by openapi:check
openapiAuthorityBoundary: OpenAPI is generated projection evidence only and cannot satisfy semantic authority without USF-native interface-contract coverage or explicit disposition.
